headline: Our repo has 100 live listings (not the 6 prior cycles measured) that form ONE demand channel - 94 of 100 inside a 5% co-movement cluster, avg r 0.980, HHI 0.010 - and the real gap is depth, not breadth: 444 w7 per live listing vs mattpocock 32,417 (72x) and corey 3,659 (8x). Our own counters run 2.28x hot (100/100 listings; competitors 1.00 on n=200), our repo index +66.6% f1->f8 is uniform across all listings (median 1.66, p10-p90 1.56-1.75) and therefore provisional, and the one competitor who bought breadth by cloning got 0.37% of the originator's flow.
claim: Measurement panel design - not the market - caused H92-H95's picture. Corrected: our repo is one 100-listing channel with a flat floor (444 w7/listing), our counters are ~2.3x inflated and ours alone, our growth is uniform to a suspicious degree, clone-breadth is measured at 0.37% capture, and the strategy implication is depth in the 6 differentiated outliers (video-editing, docker-patterns, security-review, laravel-security, rust-testing, market-research) rather than lane-rank optimization inside a tie among clones.
method: read-only: full-repo 8-window fetch of 300 listings (100 each for affaan-m/ecc, mattpocock/skills + vinvcn mirror, coreyhaines31/marketingskills; 0 failures) + 672-listing marketplace search index (10 owners) + 86-listing cross-surface board; plus live ops event stream (proposal 94727 / mission 94691 / step 94733); no external writes, no publish, no repo changes

co_movement.method: mean pairwise relative difference on 8-window series, non-zero windows only

growth.note: uniform growth across 100 listings reads as mechanism, not 100 independent demand gains; provisional until T11

mirror_capture_test.note: mirror does not track origin proportionally; breadth-by-cloning is measured dead

decay_tail.note: dead-listing share is endemic, not a lane-health differentiator

implications: Correct our own history before anything else: the repo is 100 live listings / 44,410 w7, not '3 streams / 1,409 w7'. H95's 'we overstate ourselves by 1.9x' was wrong in the opposite direction - we understated ourselves ~31x by measuring 6 of 100 listings.

Within the 94-listing cluster, per-listing rank is a tie among clones. Stop ranking-optimizing inside it; effort goes to the 6 genuine outliers and to depth (median 434 w7/listing -> target >= 1,000).
Depth, not breadth, is the gap: 72x behind mattpocock per live listing, 8x behind corey, with the widest listing base of the three (100 vs 36 vs 52) and HHI 0.010 - broad and shallow.
Clone-breadth is closed with a number (0.37% capture for the vinvcn mirror, not tracking the origin proportionally). Do not fork our own into a second owner path, do not copy a leader's catalog.

No self-positioning claim ships until T11 reconciles the 2.28x counter bias; absolute numbers about us carry a x2.3 band. Competitor numbers are clean (1.00 on n=200) - which is itself a strategic asymmetry: our visibility metrics are the ones that lie.
Our +66.6% repo growth is reported as provisional and uniform (p10-p90 1.56-1.75) - it is a mechanism-shaped signal, not yet a demand fact.
hypetopher/aicompany (3 installs) has no measurable position; keep it out of competitive claims until it has at least one listing with volume.
Lane-entry and lane-abandon decisions should use live flow per listing and differentiated-slot count, not dead-listing share (endemic: leader 15, corey 19, us 1).
risks: The 2.3x inflation mechanism is unresolved (T11): if F2 fires (the listing-page counter is the inflated one), our pool is ~1.1M-equivalent, we are top-2 in tracked installs, and every weakness narrative from H92-H95 is invalid. This is the dominant risk in the cycle.

Uniform growth across 100 listings is also explainable by a genuine repo-wide demand wave (e.g. one distribution partnership) - we cannot distinguish mechanism from a real shared shock with co-movement data alone.

Cohesion threshold is a modelling choice: a 5% rel-diff threshold merges genuinely adjacent topics, so 'one channel' may partly be an artifact of the threshold (partly mitigated - leader at 26.5% and corey at 16.4% survive the same threshold as separate).
Competitor coverage is 10 owners out of the full marketplace; a fourth large owner outside the 672-listing index would change the share denominators.

Single marketplace, 8 windows, installs != users; no revenue, retention, or usage data. Q4 seasonality uncontrolled and a market-wide wave is visible in f5->f6 (+50.5% ecc, +32.5% leader, +8.5% corey), contaminating window-level comparisons.
The branded product (3 installs) may carry the same counter bias; with no volume the bias is unmeasurable there.
tests: T11 (gating): reconcile the counter mechanism at source - fetch raw listing-page HTML for 5 of our listings and 5 competitor listings, compare rendered install counter vs search-index number vs series counter. Until resolved, 44,410 is an upper bound and 1,409 a lower bound.

T12: 3-window dispersion test - mean pairwise relDiff and 5%-cluster top size for our repo vs mattpocock vs corey. Our relDiff <= 12% while leader's >= 20% confirms 'one channel' and formally retires per-listing ranking work.
T13: mirror capture ratio over 3 windows (vinvcn/mattpocock). Reopen clone-breadth only above 5% capture.
T14: depth feasibility - does any competitor with >= 50 live listings sustain median w7/listing >= 1,000? Decides 'fewer, better' vs 'more, deeper'.
T15: re-derive our share of the 672-listing universe on listing-page counters with the 2.28 divisor and state it with an explicit error band.
falsifiers: F1: our mean pairwise relDiff > 15% or the 5%-cluster top < 70 listings next fetch => our 100 listings are genuinely differentiated; rule 2 collapses and per-listing ranking work is restored.

F2: T11 shows the rendered listing-page counter equals the search-index number => the listing-page counter is the inflated one; our pool is ~1.1M-equivalent, we are top-2 in tracked installs, and H92-H95's weakness narrative is invalid.
F3: our repo index f1->f8 reverts to flat (-10%..+10%) next window against a flat market => the +66.6% was a counter event, not demand; growth struck from all reports permanently.
F4: T14 finds a >= 50-listing competitor sustaining median w7/listing >= 1,000 => depth is reachable at scale and rule 3 becomes the primary strategy.
F5: vinvcn mirror exceeds 5% of origin flow within 3 windows => clone-breadth is reopened as a channel.

Kill rule: if T11 fails to resolve the counter and F1 also fails (i.e. both readings ambiguous), downgrade all self-positioning numbers to reporting-only with no strategic weight until a third independent counter surface is found.
rules: Report our repo at pool level (100 listings, 44,410 w7) and per-listing; never quote an individual ecc listing rank as a strategic position (94/100 are one channel).
Do not spend ranking effort on which ecc listing ranks #1 in a lane; 94 of 100 are one channel and the ranking is a tie among clones.
Depth before breadth: target median per-listing w7 >= 1,000 (today 434) before adding any new listing.
Clone-breadth closed: measured capture 0.37%; do not copy a leader's catalog or fork our own into a second owner path.
Divide our counters by ~2.3 whenever comparing to a search-index number; use listing-page counters for every ranking.
Growth claims stay provisional until the counter mechanism resolves; report repo growth with its uniformity, never as 'demand grew X%'.
Dead-listing share is not a lane-health signal (endemic: leader 15, corey 19, us 1); use live flow per listing and differentiated-slot count.
hypetopher/aicompany (3 installs) is out of competitive claims until it has at least one listing with volume.
next_experiment: T11 (gating): reconcile the 2.28x counter inflation at source using raw listing-page HTML for 5 of our listings plus 5 competitor listings; until it resolves, no self-positioning number is publishable.
kill_criterion: Kill rule: if T11 fails to resolve the counter AND F1 fails (both readings ambiguous), downgrade all self-positioning numbers to reporting-only with no strategic weight until a third independent counter surface is found.
